name: Call Desk
tagline: Makes the phone calls you keep putting off
description: Hand it an errand and it dials out on your behalf: ringing a shop to check stock, booking a table or an appointment, querying a line on a utility bill, or chasing a parcel that never turned up. Speech and telephony are wired together behind the scenes, so a real call is placed and you are told what was said.
author: Dr
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
